response.sql: WITH ab_trans AS (SELECT tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist), stats AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_count, COUNT(*) as num_groups FROM ab_trans), with_shares AS (SELECT ab_trans.ordertypedist, ab_trans.cnt, CAST(ab_trans.cnt AS REAL) / stats.total_count as share, 1.0 / stats.num_groups as avg_share FROM ab_trans, stats) SELECT ordertypedist as mix, cnt as count, share, share - avg_share as above_average FROM with_shares WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC;
